title: Spencer’s portfolio · open layout, reactive wireframes
question: Only the background carries the tactical grid. Foreground text has an open, flowing layout. Planned wireframe behavior: autonomous shape changes at rest, layered cursor response, then a smooth return to idle motion. The image is a static composition draft.
